content: Ibrahim ak-d Abimalik, ajeǧid n Jirar
Ssenni issmuṭṭiy Ibrahim iqiḍan nnes, yuyur ɣar Temmurt n Ljanub. Izdeɣ netta jar Qadac d Cur uca iqqim am ubarrani di Jirar.
Umi inna Ibrahim x Sara tamɣart nnes: “Nettat d učma i teǧa!”, issekk Abimalik, ajeǧid n Jirar, yiwi akis Sara.
Maca iḍhar-dd AREBBI i Abimalik di tarjit n ǧiret, inna as: “Aqa řexxu ad temmted di ssibbet n temɣart, tenni dd-tiwyed akidek, minzi nettat temřec ak-d weryaz.”
Maca Abimalik tuɣa war ɣares dd-iqarreb, inna: “A Sidi inu, ma xenni ad tawḍed ad tenɣed ijj n řgens iseggden?
Ma war d ayi inni netta: ‘Nettat d učma i teǧa!’, u nettat s yixef nnes tenna ɛawed: ‘Netta d uma i yeǧa!’ S tidett n wuř u s ifassen izdigen i ggiɣ aya.”
Inna as AREBBI di tarjit: “Necc ssneɣ ɛad belli teggid man aya s tidett n wuř, x uya ḥḍiɣ cek ḥima war xafi txeṭṭiḍ u war cek jjiɣ ad tt tḥadid.
Řexxu, arr tamɣart ɣar weryaz nnes, minzi netta d anabi uca netta ad xak iẓẓaǧ, ḥima ad teddared. Maca mařa war tt tarrid ca, ssen belli aqa ad temmted, cek d marra min iǧan nnec!”
Ikkar Abimalik zic ɣar ṣṣbeḥ. Iřaɣa i marra imsexxaren nnes, inna marra awařen-a deg imezzuɣen nsen uca iryazen nni dewřen ggʷeden aṭṭas.
Xenni iřaɣa Abimalik x Ibrahim uca inna as: “Min d aneɣ teggid d min di xḍiɣ akidek umi tɣeḍred xafi u x tgeldit inu ddenb ameqqran? Cek teggid akidi min war icuwwaren ad t tegged.”
Uca yarni inna Abimalik i Ibrahim: “Min cek yejjin řami teggid man aya?”
Inna Ibrahim: “Minzi nwiɣ: ‘Nican war dinni tiggʷudi zi AREBBI deg wemcan-a uca ad ayi nɣen di ssibbet n temɣart inu.’
Uca s tidett nettat ɛawed d učma. Nettat d yeǧis n baba, maca war teǧi d yeǧis n yemma uca tedweř d tamɣart inu.
Umi d ayi issetleɛ AREBBI zi taddart n baba, nniɣ as: ‘Ad yiři wa d řeɛřamet n tmexsiwt nnec icewwaren i necc, aqa ad tinid di marra imucan mani ɣa naweḍ: Netta aqa d uma!’”
Xenni iksi Abimaliki uǧi d ifunasen d tfunasin d isemɣan d tiyya uca iwca i-ten i Ibrahim uca yarr as Sara, tamɣart nnes.
Inna Abimalik: “Xzar, tammurt inu aqa-tt qibač nnec. Zdeɣ mani i d ac dd-iḍhar mliḥ di tiṭṭawin nnec.”
I Sara inna: “Xzar, wciɣ ařef n uqiyyat n nnuqart i umam. Aqa atent d ařeḥḥaf x tiṭṭawin i kuřci inni kidem iǧan, wah, i kuřci idweř am-dd d ttiqart.”
Iẓẓuǧ Ibrahim i AREBBI uca AREBBI issgenfa Abimalik d temɣart nnes d temsexxarin nnes uca urwent.
Minzi tuɣa SIDI ibelleɛ qaɛ marra řemřawat n temɣarin di taddart n Abimalik di ssibbet n Sara, tamɣart n Ibrahim.

footnotes.text: Abimalik- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘babas n ujeǧid’.
